summary: Frontend regression + 4 new features validated on PiezoLab preview URL. All 13 targeted assertions passed: Beam tab renders without runtime crash, R_opt label present on Potencia vs R_load chart, sweep animation starts (button toggles to 'Detener barrido', HUD shows 'Barrido f') and stops cleanly, Report PDF downloads as informe_piezolab.pdf (~2.3 MB with rasterized charts), Print button present, project save downloads proyecto_piezolab.json with keys {app='PiezoLab', version, savedAt, materials, tile, beam}, project load restores Longitud L slider (60→90→60) via file input, hash routing works for #tile/#beam/#cad/#materials/#report, and all 5 tabs render error-free via data-testid clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: UPlotChart redraw fix (redraw(true,true)) properly forces recalcAxes to avoid the null axis._found crash — verified stable across beam sweep animation with no pageerror events.
Consider adding an automated e2e test in the repo (Playwright) as regression guard for the sweep + PDF + project save/load flows.
seed_data_creation: None. Used app defaults (PZT-5A, L=60mm) and the app's own saved JSON to test load roundtrip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://harvestr-lab.preview.emergentagent.com . Networkidle wait times out due to constant rAF loops from Three.js/uPlot; prefer waiting for a data-testid selector instead. To move React-controlled range sliders use native value setter + input+change events. PDF generation takes ~5–10s; expect_download timeout should be >=30s. Beam sweep HUD text is 'Barrido f' (matches request).
rca of the issue: N/A — previously reported crash (uPlot drawAxesGrid reading null axis._found) already fixed upstream by main agent by passing recalcAxes=true in UPlotChart.redraw. Verified fix holds under repeated Beam tab visits, sweep start/stop, and hash navigation.
